content:
Ida Morales: Hi everyone! Ida here  starting today on Product. Remote-first but Ill be in the SF office next Tuesday. I draw comics on the side, collect silly laptop stickers, and bake the occasional loaf (warning: Im messy). Any recs for sticker swaps, best coffee, or a quiet corner to sketch? :wave:
Nikhil Rao: Welcome Ida!! :tada: We do a monthly sticker swap in the kitchen (next one is Friday). Theres also a little sketch table by the east window thats usually quiet.
Sam K.: hey hey welcome! Coffee wise - the espresso machine in the breakroom is top tier after 10am. If youre baking, bring it on Friday and youll be famous. :baguette_bread:
Claire: welcome! we have a small art group that doodles at lunch on Thursdays. also ping me if you want to join the internal zine project.
OpsBot: Onboarding reminder: please complete your HR forms and the security training at https://redwood.example.com/onboard (required for building access).
Jordan: pro tip: bring a sticker sheet and trade a few - people love vintage arcade stickers. Also the rooftop patio has great light for sketching mornings.
Priya: welcome Ida! We keep a snack stash behind the printer for emergencies. If youre into sourdough, the farmers market on Saturdays near the office has a great vendor.
Ida Morales: Amazing, thanks! Ill definitely bring stickers and maybe some mini comics. Do folks usually sit in open seating or reserve desks?
Nikhil Rao: open seating mostly, but you can reserve a hotdesk via the office app if you want a guaranteed spot. Also theres a whiteboard in the sketch corner - bring markers.
Sam K.: also heads up: badge pickup is at reception, bring an ID. People Ops stocks extra markers in the supply drawer.
Claire: if you want, I can show you the rooftop light angles next Tuesday after lunch - perfect for photos of comics.
Ida Morales: sold. See you next Tuesday! Thanks for the warm welcome :heart:
Jordan: welcome aboard - cant wait to see the comics.
Priya: welcome Ida! :sparkles:
